question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4. **
solution:
The correct answer is: **Attained**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us look at the meaning of the given words.
 
 
• **Attained**: Succeed in achieving something that one has worked for. (किसी ऐसी चीज को हासिल करने में सफल होना जिसके लिए किसी ने काम किया हो)
 
• **Displayed**: To arrange something or a collection of things so that it can be seen by the public. (किसी वस्तु या वस्तुओं के संग्रह को व्यवस्थित करना ताकि वह जनता द्वारा देखा जा सके)
 
• **Transferred**: To move someone or something from one place, vehicle, person, or group to another. (किसी व्यक्ति या वस्तु को एक स्थान, वाहन, व्यक्ति या समूह से दूसरे स्थान पर ले जाना)
 
• **Received**: Generally accepted as being right or correct because it is based on authority. (आम तौर पर सही या सही होने के रूप में स्वीकार किया जाता है क्योंकि यह अधिकार पर आधारित होता है)
 
 
 
• So, as per the meaning of the given words "**attained**" is the most appropriate option.
 
• Attaining enlightenment is a state of perfect knowledge or wisdom, combined with infinite compassion.

Therefore, the correct answer is option 1.

Complete passage: *The monastery in Tawang has recently undergone (1) renovation__ and bright paintings __(2) adorn__ its walls. Dances and ceremonial celebrations are held in the __(3) courtyard__, the most important of which is held on the night of Buddha Purnima, the full moon on which the Buddha was born, **__(4) __*****__*attained*__** *enlightenment and died. To reach Tawang, you drive for 12 hours from Assam’s Tezpur town, a major Indian Forces base. The best season the visitor can choose for coming to Tawang is (5)_________ September **and** November.*

46:T100b,

The correct answer is: **Between**
